## Overview
### Introduction to ByteDance Seed: Seed-2.0-Mini
The ByteDance Seed: Seed-2.0-Mini model, released by Bytedance-seed on 2024-01-01, is a standard tier language model that operates under a closed-source license. This model is designed to handle a variety of tasks, including but not limited to chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization. With its robust architecture, Seed-2.0-Mini is capable of processing input and generating output based on its training data, which has a knowledge cutoff of 2023-12.

### Technical Specifications and Pricing
From a technical standpoint, Seed-2.0-Mini boasts a context window of 262,144 tokens and can produce a maximum output of 131,072 tokens. The model's pricing structure is as follows: $0.1 per 1M tokens for input, $0.4 per 1M tokens for output, with no additional costs for cached input or batch input. The model's capabilities include text processing, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs. In terms of performance, Seed-2.0-Mini achieves an MMLU score of 80.0 and an LMSYS Arena ELO score of 1200. Cost examples for using this model indicate that 1,000 calls (averaging 500 tokens each) would cost approximately $0.0003, while 10,000 calls and 100,000 calls would cost $0.0029999999999999996 and $0.03, respectively.
